messages:
tara: FYI I opened a PR to update Marlin13B model card with tokenizer changes, long-context bench notes, and a short migration guide for customers using 64k windows. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4922 :rocket:

greg: thanks. two asks: 1) call out exact GPU + driver used for 64k runs, 2) add a concrete before/after tokenization example for common code snippets. customers were tripped by that last time.

mohit: agree. also we should show an SDK snippet for JS embeddings with shard_hint and fallback to append batching. quick proposed snippet below. keep it simple.

```javascript
import Redwood from '@redwoodai/sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
const stream = client.embeddings.stream({
  model: 'marlin13b',
  input: 'function add(a,b){return a+b}',
  shard_hint: 'code:high',
  fallback: { mode: 'append-batch', maxBatchMs: 40 }
})
for await (const chunk of stream) console.log(chunk.embedding.slice(0,8))
```

qa-alex: add the eval checklist before we merge: reproduce 32k/64k on the referenced hardware, run tokenization diff on 50 sample prompts, mem-smoke test repeated opens/closes. I'll schedule runs and post back (ETA ~5h).

tara: added GPU notes (A100-80GB for 64k, A100-40GB for 32k) and included the bench script link. updated "migration" section with recommended cache and batch adjustments. linking to embedding sharding doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/embeddings/sharding.

docbot: lint: models/marlin13b.md - found one broken link (line 142).

tara: fixed link, renamed shard_hint taxonomy to match docs (code:high), and assigned reviewers @greg @mohit @qa-alex. target merge by EOD to make the next catalog cut. :calendar:
